title: Deezer reports a net income of €9M in 2025, its first profit since its 2007 founding, while revenue fell 1.4% YoY to €534M (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Deezer reports a net income of €9M in 2025, its first profit since its 2007 founding, while revenue fell 1.4% YoY to €534M — Industry under threat from fraudsters uploading and repeatedly playing tracks created by AI to extract royalties
